mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recessionary expectations suppress equity valuations through reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings forecasts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as economic activity decelerates and corporate revenue growth weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or joint Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates supply chain disruption, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as inflationary pressures and output constraints reduce corporate margins and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent price pressures, prompting restrictive monetary policy that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through higher real interest rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as recession risks accelerate and corporate hiring freezes lower earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days through stronger corporate revenue growth and elevated profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500 thousand units indicate strong consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as housing-driven economic activity boosts corporate earnings and market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
